title: openapi-versions.config.json
description: Configuration of the version-aware codegen: which OpenAPI specs to merge, per API major, and from which minor (the floor) the app supports.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editor autocompletion.

specsDir.description: Directory holding one spec per released version, named <semver>.json (e.g. specs/1.4.0.json). Files whose name is not valid semver are ignored.

outDir.description: Directory the generated code is written to: <outDir>/v<major>/{schema.d.ts, meta.ts, merged.openapi.json, client.ts} and <outDir>/index.ts. Safe to delete and regenerate. Codegen replaces files in place and deletes generated v<major> dirs of majors no longer listed in majors.

majors.description: API majors this app build supports, keyed by major number. One app release normally lists exactly one.

floor.description: Oldest minor of this major the app still supports, as a plain semver (e.g. 1.3.0). A spec file named <floor>.json must exist. Operations and fields introduced after the floor are gated at runtime; everything at the floor is assumed on every supported backend.

gate.description: Breaking-change gate (oasdiff) between consecutive specs. auto: run it when oasdiff is installed, warn and skip otherwise. required: fail when oasdiff is missing or too old (use in CI, or pass --require-gate). off: never run it.

generator.description: Generator for the types (and, for hey-api, the SDK). Leave unset to use the one installed, in this order: openapi-typescript, openapi-typesafe, hey-api. openapi-typesafe supports TypeScript 5.4 to 7, needs no helpers patch and needs Node 22.12 or newer (ADR 0017). hey-api (@hey-api/openapi-ts, experimental) writes a Hey API SDK and TanStack Query helpers, needs Node 22.18 or newer, and generates with TypeScript 6 or older (ADR 0027).

runtimeImport.description: Module specifier the generated v<major>/client.ts imports the runtime from. Leave unset when the runtime is installed as the `openapi-versions` package (the default is `openapi-versions/hey-api` for the hey-api generator); set a relative path when developing the runtime in the same repo.
